meta.title: The Odyssey: the moving-image vocabulary
meta.method: Each kind of motion is found in the beats of all 152 scenes (harness/atlas.json beats and assets, locations.json places, by pattern with hand corrections). value = (scenes in the cut + 0.3 x dropped scenes) / 102 x story weight (1-3) x weakness (have 1, partial 2, missing 3) x 10.

from_score.transition: plus every scene whose score holds a rich dream (Rd), strong destiny (Sd), peaks of the present (Pp) or gaseous perception (Ga): signs that need a dissolve or superimposition
from_score.transform: plus every scene whose score holds limpid and opaque (Lo): a face clearing as another clouds, done as replacement animation

kinds.name: Embraces, recognitions and weeping
kinds.excellent: The LEGO Movie's sincerity: the joke stops and the hug is held; Nolan ends on a hand on a face (102.5). Minifigures cannot close their arms, so the embrace is the heads together and the arms up.
kinds.have: Halfworld faces with the key-beat emotions (recognition, grief, appeal) played on the principal's face; kfPhysics allows touching pairs; lip sync.
kinds.missing: Tears; the move into the embrace; the held two-shot where both faces read.
kinds.technique: An embrace key pair (arms raised to 60°, heads 4 LDU apart, a 5° lean in) eased over 8 frames and then held; tears as a trans-clear 1x1 round plate sliding down the face decal over 24 frames; recognitions framed by their sign (score.json).

kinds.name: Sea states: calm, swell, surf, the sea as ground
kinds.excellent: The LEGO Movie's sea is built from parts: rows of 1x1 round plates and tiles in trans-blue and trans-clear stepping on twos, foam of white plates at the break; Nolan's trailer keeps the sea a horizon a third up the frame, black at night with one warm light (frames 47, 51).
kinds.have: Static brick water in the landscape library (landscape.py: clear tiles over blue, foam, deep water, beach with shingle and shallows); the game's studded sea plane with a texture that can scroll; sea and sea-calm synthesised beds.
kinds.missing: No sea that moves in take or trailer mode: water is a still surface; no swell height, no surf line, no wake behind a hull, no difference between calm, swell and storm except the sky.
kinds.technique: Sea as a field of 1x2 and 2x2 trans-blue tiles on a stud grid, each row raised by a height function h(x,t) quantised to plate steps (1/3 brick) and stepped on twos (12 fps): calm = amplitude 0 with a glint layer of trans-clear 1x1 round plates toggled at random; swell = one plate of amplitude, 48-stud wavelength; storm = two bricks, crests capped with white 1x1 round plates. One instanced mesh per colour; only matrices move.

kinds.name: Crowds, assemblies and feasts
kinds.excellent: The LEGO Movie's crowds are dozens of minifigures with small individual loops (a head turn, a cup raise); Nolan keeps crowds as texture behind one figure (57).
kinds.have: Ensembles baked in the cards; kfSpread spreads a cast; idle life and blinks (Perform) on the named cast; halfworld faces on twelve principals.
kinds.missing: Crowd members are statics: no drinking, turning, laughing, no crowd reaction to a line.
kinds.technique: A crowd layer: each extra gets one of six two-pose idles (cup raise, head turn, lean, laugh, point, gamble) with a random phase, on twos; a reaction wave (all heads turn toward a source within 6 frames, nearest first) for cues like the stool and the bow.

kinds.name: Optical transitions: dissolve, double exposure, marked flashback
kinds.excellent: The time-image needs optics: the marked flashback (dissolve, warmer or monochrome, slower), the dream's superimposition, the vision inside the present.
kinds.have: Cards fade in and out; the grade can wash a frame.
kinds.missing: No shot-to-shot dissolve, no superimposition, no marked flashback look in take, trailer or game mode.
kinds.technique: A compositor pass in the exporters: crossfade two rendered frames over n frames (dissolve); additive blend at 40% for a double exposure; a 'marked past' grade (warm wash, 0.75 saturation, frames held on threes).

kinds.name: Single combat and the grapple
kinds.excellent: The LEGO Movie: fights as pose-to-pose keys at 12 fps (on twos), strong silhouettes, a held anticipation pose before every hit, a two-frame impact, a plastic clack on contact; Nolan: close, handheld, the face.
kinds.have: Pose holds from keyframes; the take eases between keys (arms and legs lerped); kfPhysics detects clashes between figures; clack sfx (clang, thud).
kinds.missing: No choreography: no anticipation, no impact frames, no reaction, no fall.
kinds.technique: A fight is a list of key poses (anticipation, strike, impact, recoil, settle) on the six minifigure joints plus a root move, held on twos with no in-betweens except the strike (one smear frame of a trans-clear arc plate); contact frames checked by kfPhysics so hands meet targets; a 2-frame camera shake and a clack on each impact.

kinds.name: Falls and deaths
kinds.excellent: A fall as two held poses and a bounce: plastic does not ragdoll; the LEGO Movie's figures fall stiff and clack.
kinds.have: Lying poses via keys.
kinds.missing: No fall between poses.
kinds.technique: Stiff-body fall: rotate the whole figure about the heel over 4 frames on twos, one-plate bounce, then settle; accessories come loose as parts.

kinds.name: Transformation (Proteus, Circe, Athena restoring and ageing Odysseus)
kinds.excellent: Replacement animation, the stop-motion way: heads, hair and torsos swapped one element at a time on twos while the camera holds; Proteus through lion, snake, water and tree in two frames each.
kinds.have: Faces are decals that can be swapped (Face.attach 'halfworld:<who>'); plain heads replace printed ones; separate disguise cast ids exist in the keyframes.
kinds.missing: No on-screen change: a disguise is a different figure between shots.
kinds.technique: A transformation track: a list of (frame, slot, part) swaps on the same rig (head, hair, torso print, legs, accessory), on twos, with a one-frame white flash on the first swap for a god and none for Athena's slow restorations; Proteus as a chain of prop replacements at a fixed mark.

kinds.name: Disguise and the god among men
kinds.excellent: The disguise is costume: rags, a hood, a staff (the wardrobe); the god is lit a little apart from the room.
kinds.have: wardrobe.py costumes; disguise cast ids (athena-as-mentor); the trailer's look can light one figure.
kinds.missing: Nothing tells the audience the god is there except the dialogue.
kinds.technique: A rim light and a 5% warmer grade on the disguised god only (a per-figure light link), and a two-frame glint when the disguise speaks as a god.

kinds.name: Rowing
kinds.excellent: LEGO: oars as long bars through clips moving in a looped four-pose cycle, the whole bank in step, a small splash of white plates at each catch; Nolan: oars out on a labouring galley (94.5).
kinds.have: The oars.ogg synthesised sfx; oar props (Elpenor's oar) as statics.
kinds.missing: No oar cycle; rowers are seated statics.
kinds.technique: A four-pose loop per oar (catch, drive, finish, recovery) on twos, the rowers' torsos leaning with it (torso.lean already in Perform); one offset for the whole bank so it reads as a crew; a splash burst (E.burst of 1x1 round white plates) at each catch.

kinds.name: Walking journeys, arrivals and departures
kinds.excellent: Nolan: men walking away from us into mist or dark (31, 66), the journey as a direction; LEGO: a waddle walk on twos, legs swinging in two poses.
kinds.have: Take mode: a walk cycle between keyframe marks (legs and arms on a sine, turn and settle, sit and rise); the camera follows a walking figure (hero framing).
kinds.missing: Trailer mode and the game's cinema have no walking; walks are only mark-to-mark, not long journeys through a landscape.
kinds.technique: Keep take mode's cycle but step it on twos (the two-pose minifig waddle); long journeys as a path through the landscape kit with a track move holding the walker small in the frame (the scale rule).

kinds.name: Battle and slaughter: the Cicones, the hall, the last clash
kinds.excellent: Nolan: the massed army soft behind two figures; the LEGO Movie: mass action as a few foreground fighters on keys plus a background of cycling extras, fast cuts on the payoff.
kinds.have: Ensembles baked into scene cards (suitors, crews) as statics; the syncwatch grammar cuts fast in books XXI-XXII.
kinds.missing: No crowd motion, no deaths, no bodies falling across tables.
kinds.technique: Three layers: two or three hero fights on keys (as single combat); a mid layer of 6-10 figures on four-pose loops (strike, parry, stagger, fall) with random offsets; a background of statics. Deaths as a two-pose fall (knees, flat) with the figure's accessories scattering as loose parts.

kinds.name: Sleep, waking and dreams
kinds.excellent: Sleep as a held body; the dream as a dissolve and a double exposure (rich dream) or a straight cut (restrained dream).
kinds.have: Seated and lying poses (r.sat); snore.ogg.
kinds.missing: No transitions: no dissolve or superimposition in any renderer.
kinds.technique: Sleep as a held lying pose (the figure laid flat on its bed or the ground, the torso rising half a plate every 48 frames for breath); waking as a two-pose rise on twos; the dream by its sign: rich dream as a dissolve and a double exposure, restrained dream as a straight cut (see transitions).

kinds.name: Animals: rams, sheep, goats, pigs, cattle
kinds.excellent: LEGO animals are single moulded parts; motion is a three-pose walk (legs are moulded, so the body bobs and the head turns) and a herd moves as a mass with offsets.
kinds.have: Built ram, pig, cow props (and black ram, red cow); pig heads for Circe's swine.
kinds.missing: No quadruped motion; a herd is a still group.
kinds.technique: Quadruped step: body bob of half a plate and head nod on a 4-frame loop on twos, the animal slid along its path; herds as boids-lite (follow a leader spline with random offsets); the rams under the men: the man tied under, moving with the ram.

kinds.name: Archery: stringing the bow, the shot through the axes
kinds.excellent: The shot is a series: the string hooked, the draw, a hold, the release on one frame, the arrow's flight through twelve rings in an insert down the line.
kinds.have: Bow, arrow and axes props; bowstring.ogg; the syncwatch insert on the bow (XXI-S07); the arrow can be placed.
kinds.missing: No stringing action, no draw, no arrow flight.
kinds.technique: Stringing: three held poses (bow braced on the thigh, the loop sliding, strung) and a pluck with the string element vibrating on ones for six frames; the shot: an arrow moved along the axis 40 studs a frame, the camera an insert down the axe line; hits as a two-frame impact and a fall.

kinds.name: Thrown and hurled things: rocks, stools, spears, the discus
kinds.excellent: A projectile on a clean arc, stepped on twos, with a readable anticipation pose and a splash or clatter at the end; Polyphemus's rock driving a wave back at the ship.
kinds.have: Boulder, stool props; rock.ogg, clatter.
kinds.missing: No projectile motion.
kinds.technique: Parabolic arc sampled on twos with a spin of 30° per frame, a motion trail of three fading copies at 30% opacity; at impact a burst of loose plates or white water plates.

kinds.name: Sailing under sail
kinds.excellent: Nolan: two ships as silhouettes against dusk, the sail the only shape (frame 51); a galley labouring side-on in a heavy sea (94.5). LEGO: the sail is a printed cloth or a curved slope wall that bellies in three held shapes.
kinds.have: Ship sets exist as kit builds (black ship, raft, Phaeacian ship in the cards); trailer camera moves (track, crane) can travel with a still ship; wind sfx.
kinds.missing: No hull motion (bob, pitch, roll, heel under wind), no sail that fills, no wake; a ship at sea reads as a building.
kinds.technique: Three sail replacements (slack, half, full belly) swapped on twos as the wind rises; the hull on a rig that pitches ±4° and heaves one plate on the sea's own h(x,t) at the bow and stern; a wake of white 1x1 round plates spawned at the stern and fading after 24 frames.

kinds.name: Fire, smoke and steam
kinds.excellent: LEGO: flame elements (the 'flame' part in trans-orange and trans-yellow) swapped on twos; smoke as stacked round bricks drifting up and fading; Nolan: one warm source in blue night (47, 71, 82).
kinds.have: Warm practicals flicker (trailer: point lights modulated by a sine noise); fire.ogg; ember and steam props; E.burst plate bursts.
kinds.missing: No flame geometry that moves, no smoke column, no steam.
kinds.technique: Flame: three flame-element replacements cycled on twos with the existing light flicker in phase; smoke: 1x1 and 2x2 round bricks in light and dark grey spawned at the source every 4 frames, rising 1 plate a frame, drifting with the wind vector, fading and removed after 36 frames; steam (the blinding) the same in white, faster.

kinds.name: Weather and sky: dawn, dusk, night, fog, the sun held back
kinds.excellent: Nolan: hard low sun or blue night with one warm source, overcast haze by day, horizons a quarter to a third up the frame (rules 3-4). The sun held back (XXIII) is a dawn that stops.
kinds.have: The keyframe look (sky gradient, fog distances, exposure, fill, a sun key placed by words: 'low sun behind', 'moon, high left'), trailer overrides for time of day, night dimming, grade (vignette, wash, letterbox).
kinds.missing: Time does not pass inside a shot: no light that changes (dawn rising, the sun held back, a day compressed).
kinds.technique: Animate the look: interpolate sky, fog and sun elevation over a shot from a start look to an end look, stepped on twos (the sun as a brick disc on a rig for wides); 'the sun held back' is a dawn that rises for 4 s and then freezes while the rest moves.

kinds.name: Eating, drinking and devouring
kinds.excellent: One gesture: a cup raised, a bite; the Cyclops's devouring seen in the faces and a shadow.
kinds.have: Cup, bowl, wine props; the listening carriage.
kinds.missing: No hand-to-mouth action.
kinds.technique: A two-pose cup raise (arm at 0° and 110°) on twos; devouring as silhouette on the cave wall.

kinds.name: Ghosts rising; the dead
kinds.excellent: The dead as translucent figures in a continuous mist, rising from the ground; Nolan's ashen shore with braziers (82).
kinds.have: The land-of-the-dead kit; a shade prop; the Tiresias figure.
kinds.missing: No translucency, no rising, no pass-through (Anticleia's three embraces need arms that pass through).
kinds.technique: Ghost material: the figure's meshes at 0.45 opacity, trans-clear tint, depth-write off, a slow 2-plate bob; rising = the figure raised through the floor over 24 frames on twos; the embrace: the living figure's arms keyed through the shade with kfPhysics told to ignore the pair.

kinds.name: The Cyclops
kinds.excellent: Nolan's restraint: the Cyclops shown in faces and a hand at the frame edge; the LEGO scale of a big-fig built from bricks, moved slowly and heavily on twos.
kinds.have: A built Polyphemus with pose variants (polyphemus, polyphemusSprawl, polyphemusRoar), the cyclops kit and a rendered film (films/odyssey-cyclops.mp4); his halfworld face.
kinds.missing: No locomotion (walking, stooping, groping), no grab, no rock throw.
kinds.technique: Treat him as a stop-motion puppet: 6-8 key poses per action (stoop, reach, grab, lift, smash) swapped as replacement builds on twos; his steps shake the camera by 1 plate; his scale told by men in the foreground.

kinds.name: Birds and omens: eagles, hawk and dove, geese
kinds.excellent: One sharp action in the sky: two eagles slashing at each other, a hawk tearing a dove; held to one idea per shot.
kinds.have: Nothing but the words.
kinds.missing: No bird models or flight.
kinds.technique: Birds as small brick builds with two wing positions swapped on ones (fast), on an air path; omen shots are inserts (OBJ) on sky only.

kinds.name: Bathing, washing and foot-washing
kinds.excellent: The basin, the hands, the scar under water; the foot dropped and the water spilling in an insert.
kinds.have: Basin and spill props; the scar as a set piece.
kinds.missing: No water motion in a vessel; no spill.
kinds.technique: Water in a basin as a trans-blue tile that ripples by swapping to two ring variants; the spill as the basin tipping on twos and a spill prop sliding out.

kinds.name: Dance and song
kinds.excellent: The Phaeacian ball dance as precise leaps and exchanges; the bard's hands on the lyre; the wedding noise heard from the street.
kinds.have: lyre.ogg; the bed tracks; the Perform idle; lip sync for the singer's lines.
kinds.missing: No dance loops, no hand motion on the lyre.
kinds.technique: Dance: an 8-pose loop per dancer (step, leap, turn) on twos, dancers phased in pairs; the lyre: a two-pose strum on ones in the strumming beats.

kinds.name: Ship in storm; lightning; the storm at human scale
kinds.excellent: Nolan: grey spray almost erasing the image, a body flung through the air, then a wet face and a red sail close (88-97): the storm told in spray and a face. LEGO: lightning as a yellow lightning-bolt element held for two frames, the set lit white for one.
kinds.have: Look overrides make a storm sky (dark gradient, fog, dim); storm, thunder, wind-howl sfx; handheld wobble on the trailer camera.
kinds.missing: No rain, no spray, no lightning flash, no hull roll, no one thrown by a wave.
kinds.technique: Storm = sea at storm amplitude + rain rig + spray bursts: rain as trans-clear 1x1 round plates on vertical streak rigs (a column of 4 plates stretched 3x in y) falling 2 plates per frame on twos; spray as white 1x1 round plates bursting at crests; lightning as a one-frame white exposure plus the bolt element for two frames, synced to thunder.ogg.

kinds.name: Building: the raft, the stake, the bed
kinds.excellent: The film's native act: a model growing brick by brick on the beat, as the brick title card builds its letters at 12 plates a second.
kinds.have: The brick card's build animation (12 a second); every set is a list of parts in build order (the Butter cards).
kinds.missing: No set builds itself on screen.
kinds.technique: Build-on-screen: reveal a card's rows in build order, n parts per frame on twos, each part dropping 1 plate onto its studs with a click sfx (stud.ogg); the raft in four matched top-down stages (V-S04).

kinds.name: A god's flight and descent
kinds.excellent: A figure crossing the frame fast on a clear arc, a streak behind; the LEGO answer is a minifigure on a transparent stand, moved on twos with a motion trail.
kinds.have: The trailer's crane and track moves can travel through space.
kinds.missing: No figure can leave the ground (take mode walks between marks on the floor).
kinds.technique: An air path for a figure: a spline between marks, the figure in a flying pose (arms back), moved on twos, a trail of three trans-clear copies; for the eagle and swallow forms, the transformation below then the bird on the same path.

kinds.name: Shipwreck, drifting and swimming
kinds.excellent: LEGO: a model coming apart brick by brick, pieces tumbling on twos; Nolan: a figure tiny in the water, the scale shot. The swimmer is a head and arms in the surf, not a full figure.
kinds.have: Keel, raft, veil and fig-tree props as statics; splash sfx.
kinds.missing: No breaking apart, no swimming pose cycle, no half-submerged figure (the sea is a floor, not a volume).
kinds.technique: Break-apart: the ship's parts given outward velocities and spins, stepped on twos, gravity to the sea surface, then bobbing on h(x,t); swimmer: a torso-and-head rig set at water level with a two-pose crawl stroke on twos and a white-plate splash each stroke; the sea tiles drawn over the figure's legs (a cut-away of the water plane).

kinds.name: Divine mist and darkness that hide a figure
kinds.excellent: A veil around one figure only: the city sharp, the hero half there; LEGO would build it from trans-clear plates as a shell around the minifigure.
kinds.have: Global scene fog.
kinds.missing: No local mist on one figure or area; no mist that lifts.
kinds.technique: A shell of trans-clear and trans-white 1x1 plates around the figure, opacity 0.35, drifting one plate per 6 frames; lifting it = removing plates top-down on twos (VII-S03).

kinds.name: The dog: Argos and the farm dogs
kinds.excellent: Argos's ears drop and his tail moves: tiny moves held long; the farm dogs rush in a pack.
kinds.have: Argos, dog, black and white dog props.
kinds.missing: No tail, ears or head motion; no rush.
kinds.technique: Argos: tail and head as separate hinged parts keyed on twos (lift, drop ears, tail three beats, head down); the rush: the quadruped step at double speed with a 1-plate jump at the end.

kinds.name: Weaving and the loom
kinds.excellent: The shuttle across, the beater down, the web growing row by row; unweaving as the same film backwards.
kinds.have: Loom props (loomFull, loomHalf); the penelopes-loom kit.
kinds.missing: No shuttle or web motion.
kinds.technique: The web as rows of 1x1 plates revealed one row per beat; unweaving is the reveal reversed; the weaver's arms on a two-pose loop (throw, beat).

kinds.name: Whirlpool
kinds.excellent: Concentric rings of trans-blue and white tiles turning at different speeds, the centre dropping away; the ship tilted toward it.
kinds.have: A whirl prop (static) and whirlpool.ogg.
kinds.missing: No rotation, no funnel.
kinds.technique: Five rings of 1x1 round plates on turntable rigs, inner rings faster (angular speed doubling inward), each ring one plate lower than the last; stepped on twos; a spray burst every 12 frames at the rim.

kinds.name: Binding, hanging, ropes and cables
kinds.excellent: Rope as a real thing that holds a body: the mast (XII), the gate cable (XXI), the rafter (XXII).
kinds.have: kfRope: rope tubes wound round a figure and a post, with hauled ends to named hands (the Sirens' mast).
kinds.missing: Rope does not tighten or move.
kinds.technique: Tighten by shrinking the rope's radius over 6 frames on twos when the crew hauls.

kinds.name: Horses, chariots, mule carts
kinds.excellent: A chariot running on a road with the landscape passing; wheels turning.
kinds.have: A horse prop, vehicle library.
kinds.missing: No wheel rotation or gait.
kinds.technique: Wheels rotated by distance travelled; horse gait as the quadruped loop at 4x speed; the landscape handed through the frame by a track move.

kinds.name: Scylla and the strait
kinds.excellent: Six necks striking from the cliff, each head a separate animation offset; the men lifted and gone in two seconds.
kinds.have: scyllaStrike and scyllaLift pose props; the scylla-charybdis kit.
kinds.missing: No strike motion between the poses.
kinds.technique: Each neck a chain of 1x1 round bricks on a spline; strike = three keys (coiled, extended, lifted) on twos, the six necks offset by 3 frames; a man attached to the head at the lift key.

kinds.name: The Laestrygonians
kinds.excellent: Giants on the cliff rim in silhouette hurling boulders into a harbour full of ships.
kinds.have: Laestrygon props (three colours, a girl, Antiphates).
kinds.missing: No throwing, no ships breaking.
kinds.technique: Reuse the thrown-object arc and the break-apart; giants as three-pose throwing loops on the rim.
